Eles ouviram que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, [estás] no meio deste povo, que olho a olho {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, és visto, e a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} nuvem está sobre eles, e numa coluna de nuvem {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vais adiante deles de dia, e numa coluna de fogo de noite.
pt.B: e eles contarão isso aos que vivem nesta terra. Esses já ouviram que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, estás presente no meio deste povo; que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} mostras a eles abertamente, olho no olho; que a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} nuvem paira sobre eles; e que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vais à frente deles numa coluna de nuvem de dia e numa coluna de fogo de noite.
pt.R: Eles vão contar isso aos que moram nesta terra. Esse povo já ouviu que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, estás com Israel. Eles sabem que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} deixas ver face a face, que a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} nuvem fica sobre o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo, e que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vais à frente deles numa coluna de nuvem de dia e numa coluna de fogo de noite.

am.L: ለዚህችም ምድር ነዋሪዎች ይነግሯቸዋል። አንተ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በዚህ ሕዝብ መካከል እንዳለህ፣ አንተ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ዓይን በዓይን እንደምትታይ፣ ደመናህም በላያቸው እንደሚቆም፣ በቀንም በደመና ዓምድ በሌሊትም በእሳት ዓምድ በፊታቸው እንደምትሄድ ሰምተዋል።
am.B: ለዚህችም ምድር ነዋሪዎች ይነግሯቸዋል። እነዚህም አንተ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በዚህ ሕዝብ መካከል እንዳለህ፣ አንተ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ዓይን በዓይን በግልጥ እንደምትገለጥላቸው፣ ደመናህ በላያቸው እንደሚያርፍ፣ በቀንም በደመና ዓምድ በሌሊትም በእሳት ዓምድ በፊታቸው እየመራህ እንደምትሄድ ሰምተዋል።
am.R: በዚህች ምድር ለሚኖሩት ሰዎች ይነግራሉ። እነዚያ ሰዎች አንተ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከእስራኤል ጋር እንዳለህ አስቀድመው ሰምተዋል። ፊት ለፊት እንድትታይ እንደምትፈቅድ፣ ደመናህ በሕዝብህ ላይ እንደሚቆይ፣ ቀን በደመና ዓምድ ሌሊትም በእሳት ዓምድ ቀድመሃቸው እንደምትሄድ ያውቃሉ።

decisions.choice: they will say to the inhabitants of this land; they have heard: the news will reach people who already know of God's presence
alternatives: the Egyptians have heard that you are among this people
they will say to the inhabitants of this land that they have heard ...
decisions.reason: The connection of the two clauses is loose in the Hebrew. Most likely the Egyptians will tell the people of Canaan, who have themselves heard what the LORD does for Israel (compare Exodus 15:14-16; Joshua 2:9-11). It may also be the Egyptians who "have heard", or the clause may say what they will tell. In each reading the point is the same: the nations know that the LORD is with this people.

decisions.choice: eye to eye you are seen: you show yourself openly, close at hand
decisions.reason: "Eye to eye" means directly and plainly, face to face (Isaiah 52:8). It describes how near and visible the LORD's presence is to Israel, in the cloud and fire, and in the way he speaks with Moses (12:8; Exodus 33:11).

decisions.choice: your cloud ... a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night
decisions.reason: The cloud stood over the tabernacle and led Israel on its journeys (9:15-23; 10:34), and the pillar of cloud and fire went before them from the start (Exodus 13:21-22).

decisions.choice: show yourself to them openly, eye to eye
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the Hebrew picture and adds "openly" to say what it means. Readable uses the English idiom "face to face".

decisions.choice: with Israel; over your people
decisions.reason: Readable names the people rather than repeating "this people".

decisions.choice: "toi, SEIGNEUR" with the divine_name span on "SEIGNEUR|Yahvé" alone
decisions.reason: The name stands in apposition to "you", as an address; French drops the article in address, so the span carries the name without "le", and both options ("toi, SEIGNEUR", "toi, Yahvé") read naturally.

decisions.choice: "mắt đối mắt" (L); "tỏ mình ra cho họ thấy tận mắt" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture; Balanced and Readable say God shows himself openly, close at hand (meaning decision). "trụ mây" and "trụ lửa" are the term sheet's words.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서" in address
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "you, the LORD" twice; Korean prayer speaks to God with the honorific third person, so the divine name with 께서 already says "you". "주님의 구름" keeps "your cloud".

decisions.choice: olho a olho (L); olho no olho (B); face a face (R)
decisions.reason: "Olho no olho" is the Portuguese phrase for meeting someone directly and openly (m2), and Balanced uses it as the English Balanced keeps "eye to eye"; Literal keeps the Hebrew "olho a olho". Readable says "face a face", as the English Readable does. The divine name stands after "tu" in apposition, so the span reads "tu, o SENHOR" or "tu, Javé".

source.text: וְהֵמַתָּ֛ה אֶת־הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה כְּאִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֑ד וְאָֽמְרוּ֙ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־שָׁמְע֥וּ אֶֽת־שִׁמְעֲךָ֖ לֵאמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will put to death the people the this as man one, and will say the nations which have heard your fame, saying,

en.L: And [if] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} put this people to death as one man, then the nations who have heard {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} fame will say, saying,
en.B: If {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} now kill this people all at once, the nations that have heard the report about {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will say,
en.R: If {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} kill all these people at one time, the nations who have heard about {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will say,

es.L: Y [si] {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} das muerte a este pueblo como a un solo hombre, entonces las naciones que han oído {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fama dirán, diciendo:
es.B: Si ahora {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} matas a todo este pueblo de una vez, las naciones que han oído hablar de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} dirán:
es.R: Si matas a toda esta gente de una sola vez, las naciones que han oído hablar de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} dirán:

fr.L: Et [si] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais mourir ce peuple comme un seul homme, alors les nations qui ont entendu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} renommée diront, en disant :
fr.B: Si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais maintenant mourir ce peuple tout entier d’un seul coup, les nations qui ont entendu parler de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} diront :
fr.R: Si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} tues tous ces gens en une seule fois, les nations qui ont entendu parler de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} vont dire :

sw.L: Na [kama] {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ukiwaua watu hawa kama mtu mmoja, ndipo mataifa yaliyosikia sifa {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} yatasema, yakisema,
sw.B: Kama ukiwaua watu hawa wote mara moja, mataifa yaliyosikia habari {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} yatasema,
sw.R: Kama utawaua watu hawa wote kwa wakati mmoja, mataifa yaliyosikia habari {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} yatasema,

vi.L: Và [nếu] {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giết dân này như một người, thì các dân tộc đã nghe danh tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nói rằng:
vi.B: Nếu bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giết dân này cùng một lúc, thì các dân tộc đã nghe danh tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nói:
vi.R: Nếu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giết hết dân này trong một lần, thì các dân tộc đã nghe về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nói:

ko.L: 그리고 [만일] 주님께서 이 백성을 한 사람같이 죽이시면, 주님의 명성을 들은 민족들이 말할 것입니다.
ko.B: 이제 주님께서 이 백성을 한꺼번에 죽이신다면, 주님의 소문을 들은 민족들이 이렇게 말할 것입니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 이 백성을 한꺼번에 모두 죽이시면, 주님에 대하여 들은 민족들이 이렇게 말할 것입니다.

pt.L: E [se] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} matares este povo como um só homem, então as nações que ouviram a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} fama dirão, dizendo:
pt.B: Se agora {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} matares este povo todo de uma vez, as nações que ouviram falar de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} dirão:
pt.R: Se {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} matares todo este povo de uma só vez, as nações que ouviram falar de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} vão dizer:

am.L: ይህንም ሕዝብ እንደ አንድ ሰው [ብትገድል]፣ ዝናህን የሰሙ ሕዝቦች እንዲህ ሲሉ ይናገራሉ፦
am.B: አሁን ይህን ሕዝብ በአንድ ጊዜ ብትገድለው ስለ አንተ ወሬ የሰሙ ሕዝቦች እንዲህ ይላሉ፦
am.R: እነዚህን ሰዎች ሁሉ በአንድ ጊዜ ብትገድል፣ ስለ አንተ የሰሙ ሕዝቦች እንዲህ ይላሉ፦

decisions.choice: as one man: all together, at a single stroke
decisions.reason: "As one man" means all at once, as if the whole people were a single person struck down (Judges 20:1, 8 use it of a people acting together).

decisions.choice: and you will put to death: a condition, if you kill
decisions.reason: The verb form joined by "and" sets out a case: if God did what verse 12 says, this is what would follow. Verse 16 gives what the nations would say.

decisions.choice: your fame: the report about you
decisions.reason: The word means what is heard about someone, his reputation. The nations have heard about the LORD's deeds (Exodus 15:14; Joshua 9:9).

decisions.choice: [if]
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sets out the condition with a verb form alone; Literal supplies "if" in brackets, and Balanced and Readable simply say "if".

decisions.choice: "ሕዝቦች" (peoples, nations) for the goyim
decisions.reason: As in Genesis and Exodus, the nations here are the peoples around Israel; "አሕዛብ" reads as "Gentiles", the New Testament contrast with Jews.

source.text: מִבִּלְתִּ֞י יְכֹ֣לֶת יְהוָ֗ה לְהָבִיא֙ אֶת־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֶל־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֣ע לָהֶ֑ם וַיִּשְׁחָטֵ֖ם בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Because not able [was] Yahweh to bring the people the this into the land which he swore to them, and he slaughtered them in the wilderness.

en.L: 'Because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was not able to bring this people into the land which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} swore to them, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} slaughtered them in the wilderness.'
en.B: 'It was because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was unable to bring this people into the land {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had sworn to give them that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} butchered them in the wilderness.'
en.R: '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} was not strong enough to bring these people into the land {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} promised them. So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} killed them out in the desert.'

es.L: “Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no pudo llevar a este pueblo a la tierra que les había jurado, los degolló en el desierto”.
es.B: “Como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no fue capaz de llevar a este pueblo a la tierra que les había jurado dar, los masacró en el desierto”.
es.R: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no tuvo fuerza suficiente para llevar a esta gente a la tierra que les prometió. Por eso los mató en el desierto”.

fr.L: “Parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’était pas capable de faire entrer ce peuple dans le pays qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur avait juré, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a égorgés dans le désert.”
fr.B: “C’est parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} était incapable de faire entrer ce peuple dans le pays qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait juré de leur donner qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a massacrés dans le désert.”
fr.R: “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’était pas assez fort pour faire entrer ces gens dans le pays qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur avait promis. Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a tués dans le désert.”

sw.L: 'Kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakuweza kuwaingiza watu hawa katika nchi aliyowaapia, amewachinja nyikani.'
sw.B: 'Ni kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alishindwa kuwaingiza watu hawa katika nchi aliyoapa kuwapa, ndiyo maana amewachinja nyikani.'
sw.R: '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakuwa na nguvu za kutosha kuwaingiza watu hawa katika nchi aliyowaahidi. Kwa hiyo aliwaua huko jangwani.'

vi.L: 'Bởi vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không thể đem dân này vào xứ mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thề với họ, nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tàn sát họ trong hoang mạc.'
vi.B: 'Chính vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không đủ sức đem dân này vào xứ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thề ban cho họ, nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tàn sát họ trong hoang mạc.'
vi.R: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không đủ sức đưa dân này vào xứ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa với họ. Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giết họ trong hoang mạc.'

ko.L: '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 이 백성을 그가 그들에게 맹세한 땅으로 데려갈 수 없었기 때문에, 그가 광야에서 그들을 도살했다.'
ko.B: '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 이 백성에게 주겠다고 맹세한 땅으로 그들을 데려갈 능력이 없었다. 그래서 광야에서 그들을 마구 죽여 버린 것이다.'
ko.R: '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 이 백성에게 약속한 땅으로 그들을 데려갈 힘이 없었다. 그래서 그들을 광야에서 죽여 버렸다.'

pt.L: 'Porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não foi capaz de fazer este povo entrar na terra que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes jurou, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os abateu no deserto.'
pt.B: 'Foi porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não conseguiu levar este povo para a terra que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha jurado lhes dar que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os massacrou no deserto.'
pt.R: '{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} não teve força para levar este povo para a terra que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes prometeu. Por isso {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os matou lá no deserto.'

am.L: “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይህን ሕዝብ ወደ ማለላቸው ምድር ሊያገባቸው ስላልቻለ በምድረ በዳ አረዳቸው።”
am.B: “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይህን ሕዝብ ሊሰጣቸው ወደ ማለላቸው ምድር ሊያገባቸው ስላልቻለ ነው በምድረ በዳ ያረዳቸው።”
am.R: “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እነዚህን ሰዎች ቃል ወደ ገባላቸው ምድር ለማስገባት አቅም አልነበረውም። ስለዚህ በምድረ በዳ ገደላቸው።”

decisions.choice: because the LORD was not able: the nations would think God powerless
decisions.reason: Moses' argument is that the nations would not see judgment but failure: a God who could bring Israel out of Egypt but could not bring them in. Deuteronomy 9:28 repeats it.

decisions.choice: the land which he swore to them: the land he promised them on oath
decisions.reason: God swore to give the land to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob and their descendants (Genesis 26:3; Exodus 13:5; 32:13). "To them" here means to this people, as the heirs of that oath; verse 23 says "to their fathers".

decisions.choice: slaughtered: killed like animals
decisions.reason: The verb is used of killing animals for food or sacrifice, and so of killing people without mercy. It is how the nations would describe what God had done.

decisions.choice: had sworn to give them
decisions.reason: Balanced says "to give", which the oath about the land implies.

decisions.choice: The nations speak of God without the honorific ("{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는", "그가")
decisions.reason: The words are put in the mouth of nations who scorn the LORD as powerless (meaning decision); Korean marks the scorn by leaving out the honorific they would not give him.

decisions.choice: os abateu (L); os massacrou (B)
decisions.reason: The verb is used of killing animals (m3). Literal says "abater", the Portuguese word for slaughtering animals, so the picture shows; Balanced says "massacrar", killing without mercy, as the English says "butchered"; Readable says "matar".

source.text: וְעַתָּ֕ה יִגְדַּל־נָ֖א כֹּ֣חַ אֲדֹנָ֑י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ לֵאמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, let be great please [the] power of my Lord, just as you have spoken, saying,

en.L: And now, please, let the power of my Lord be great, just as {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have spoken, saying,
en.B: So now, I pray, let the power of my Lord be shown to be great, as {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have declared:
en.R: So now, Lord, please show how great {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} power is. You said:

es.L: Y ahora, por favor, sea grande el poder de mi Señor, tal como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hablado, diciendo:
es.B: Así que ahora, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} ruego que el poder de mi Señor se muestre grande, como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has declarado:
es.R: Así que ahora, Señor, por favor, muestra lo grande que es {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} poder. Tú dijiste:

fr.L: Et maintenant, de grâce, que la puissance de mon Seigneur soit grande, comme {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as dit, en disant :
fr.B: Maintenant donc, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en supplie, que la puissance de mon Seigneur se montre grande, comme {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as déclaré :
fr.R: Alors maintenant, Seigneur, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en prie, montre combien {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} puissance est grande. Tu as dit :

sw.L: Na sasa, tafadhali, nguvu za Bwana wangu na ziwe kuu, kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulivyosema, ukisema,
sw.B: Basi sasa, nakusihi, nguvu za Bwana wangu zionekane kuwa kuu, kama ulivyotangaza:
sw.R: Basi sasa, Bwana, tafadhali onyesha jinsi nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zilivyo kuu. Ulisema,

vi.L: Và bây giờ, xin quyền năng của Chúa tôi được tỏ ra lớn lao, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán rằng:
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ, con cầu xin, xin cho quyền năng của Chúa được tỏ ra lớn lao, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán:
vi.R: Vậy bây giờ, lạy Chúa, xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho thấy quyền năng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lớn lao dường nào. Ngài đã phán:

ko.L: 그러니 이제 제발, 주님께서 말씀하신 대로 내 주님의 능력이 크게 되게 하십시오. 주님께서 말씀하시기를,
ko.B: 그러니 이제 간구합니다. 주님께서 말씀하신 대로, 내 주님의 크신 능력을 드러내 주십시오. 주님께서는 이렇게 말씀하셨습니다.
ko.R: 그러니 이제 주님, 주님의 능력이 얼마나 크신지 보여 주십시오. 주님께서는 이렇게 말씀하셨습니다.

pt.L: E agora, por favor, que seja grande o poder do meu Senhor, como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} falaste, dizendo:
pt.B: Agora, pois, eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} peço: que o poder do meu Senhor se mostre grande, como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} declaraste:
pt.R: Agora, Senhor, por favor, mostra como é grande o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} poder. Tu mesmo disseste:

am.L: አሁንም እባክህ፣ እንዲህ ብለህ እንደ ተናገርህ የጌታዬ ኃይል ታላቅ ይሁን፦
am.B: ስለዚህ አሁን እለምንሃለሁ፣ እንዲህ ብለህ እንደ ተናገርህ የጌታዬ ኃይል ታላቅ መሆኑ ይገለጥ፦
am.R: ስለዚህ ጌታ ሆይ፣ አሁን እባክህ ኃይልህ ምን ያህል ታላቅ እንደ ሆነ አሳይ። አንተ እንዲህ ብለሃል፦

decisions.choice: my Lord: a title of respect for God
decisions.reason: This is not the divine name but the title "Lord", "my master", used in respectful address (Exodus 4:10; 34:9). Moses speaks of God in the third person, as a servant addresses his master.

decisions.choice: let the power of my Lord be great: let God's strength be shown in forgiving
decisions.reason: Moses asks God to show his power, which the nations would doubt (verse 16), not by destroying the people but by keeping his word about his own character, which Moses quotes next (verse 18). Power here is the power to forgive and still bring the people in.

decisions.choice: be shown to be great
decisions.reason: God's power cannot grow; the request is that it be seen to be great. Balanced adds "shown".

decisions.choice: Lord, please show how great your power is
decisions.reason: Readable turns Moses' respectful third person ("the power of my Lord") into direct address, which is how the request reads in plain English.

decisions.choice: "Chúa tôi" (L); "Chúa" (B, R) for my Lord (Adonai)
decisions.reason: The Genesis terms note gives "Chúa" for Adonai, never in capitals, so that it is not confused with "CHÚA" for the divine name; Literal keeps "my".

decisions.choice: "내 주님" for *Adonai* with the suffix
decisions.reason: A title of respect for God (meaning decision); "주님" for Adonai, as the Genesis sheet, distinct from the divine-name span.

decisions.choice: o meu Senhor (L, B); Senhor (R)
decisions.reason: The word is the title Adonai, not the divine name (m1), so it is "Senhor" with a capital S only, never in capitals and with no divine_name span (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md). Literal and Balanced keep Moses' respectful third person; Readable turns it into direct address with "tu", as the English Readable does.

source.text: יְהוָ֗ה אֶ֤רֶךְ אַפַּ֨יִם֙ וְרַב־חֶ֔סֶד נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֖ן וָפָ֑שַׁע וְנַקֵּה֙ לֹ֣א יְנַקֶּ֔ה פֹּקֵ֞ד עֲוֺ֤ן אָבוֹת֙ עַל־בָּנִ֔ים עַל־שִׁלֵּשִׁ֖ים וְעַל־רִבֵּעִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Yahweh [is] long of anger(s) and great of steadfast love, lifting iniquity and transgression, and leaving unpunished not he leaves unpunished, visiting [the] iniquity of fathers on sons, on third-generation and on fourth-generation.

en.L: '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [is] long of anger and great of steadfast love, bearing iniquity and transgression; but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will by no means acquit [the guilty], visiting the iniquity of fathers on {{gender:children|sons}}, on the third and on the fourth [generation].'
en.B: '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is slow to grow angry and rich in faithful love, forgiving wrongdoing and rebellion. Yet {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will never acquit the guilty; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brings the wrongdoing of {{gender:parents|fathers}} upon their {{gender:children|sons}}, to the third and the fourth generation.'
en.R: '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is slow to become angry, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful love is great. He forgives wrongdoing and rebellion. But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not let the guilty go free. He deals with the sin of {{gender:parents|fathers}} in the lives of their {{gender:children|sons}}, even as far as the third and fourth generation.'

es.L: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] lento para la ira y grande en amor fiel, que carga con la iniquidad y la rebelión; pero de ningún modo absuelve [al culpable], visitando la iniquidad de los padres sobre los hijos, sobre la tercera y sobre la cuarta [generación]”.
es.B: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es lento para enojarse y rico en amor fiel; perdona la maldad y la rebelión. Pero nunca declara inocente al culpable; hace recaer la maldad de los padres sobre sus hijos, hasta la tercera y la cuarta generación”.
es.R: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no se enoja fácilmente, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel es grande. Perdona el mal y la rebelión. Pero no deja que el culpable quede libre. Pide cuentas del pecado de los padres en la vida de sus hijos, hasta la tercera y aun la cuarta generación”.

fr.L: “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] lent à la colère et grand en amour fidèle, qui lève la faute et la transgression ; mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne tient nullement [le coupable] pour innocent, visitant la faute des pères sur les {{gender:enfants|fils}}, sur la troisième et sur la quatrième [génération].”
fr.B: “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est lent à se mettre en colère et riche en amour fidèle ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pardonne la faute et la rébellion. Pourtant {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne déclare jamais innocent le coupable ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait retomber la faute des {{gender:parents|pères}} sur leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}}, jusqu’à la troisième et la quatrième génération.”
fr.R: “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne se met pas vite en colère, et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle est grand. Il pardonne le mal et la révolte. Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne laisse pas le coupable impuni. Il demande compte du péché des {{gender:parents|pères}} jusque dans la vie de leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}}, jusqu’à la troisième et même la quatrième génération.”

sw.L: '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mkawivu wa hasira na mwingi wa upendo usiokoma, akiuchukua uovu na uasi; lakini hamhesabu kamwe [mwenye hatia] kuwa hana hatia, akiuleta uovu wa baba juu ya watoto, juu ya [kizazi cha] tatu na juu ya [kizazi cha] nne.'
sw.B: '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huchelewa kukasirika, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} amejaa upendo usiokoma; husamehe uovu na uasi. Hata hivyo hamtangazi kamwe mwenye hatia kuwa hana hatia; huuleta uovu wa wazazi juu ya watoto wao, hadi kizazi cha tatu na cha nne.'
sw.R: '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakasiriki upesi, na upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma ni mkubwa. Husamehe uovu na uasi. Lakini hamwachi mwenye hatia aende huru. Hushughulikia dhambi ya wazazi katika maisha ya watoto wao, hata mpaka kizazi cha tatu na cha nne.'

vi.L: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chậm giận và dồi dào tình yêu thương thành tín, tha thứ gian ác và sự phạm luật; nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chẳng hề coi [kẻ có tội] là vô tội, thăm phạt gian ác của cha trên con cái, đến [đời] thứ ba và [đời] thứ tư.'
vi.B: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chậm nóng giận, giàu tình yêu thương thành tín, tha thứ tội lỗi và sự phạm luật. Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không bao giờ coi kẻ có tội là vô tội; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bắt tội lỗi của {{gender:cha mẹ|cha ông}} đổ trên con cháu, cho đến đời thứ ba và đời thứ tư.'
vi.R: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chậm giận, và tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật lớn lao. Ngài tha thứ điều ác và sự phản nghịch. Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không để kẻ có tội được thoát. Hậu quả tội lỗi của {{gender:cha mẹ|cha ông}} sẽ đổ trên đời sống con cháu, cho đến đời thứ ba và đời thứ tư.'

ko.L: '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 분노를 오래 참고 한결같은 사랑이 크며, 죄악과 허물을 용서하지만, 결코 [죄 있는 자를] 죄 없다 하지 않고, 아버지들의 죄악을 {{gender:자녀|아들들}}에게, 삼 대와 사 대에까지 갚는다.'
ko.B: '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 쉽게 노하지 않고 한결같은 사랑이 넘치며, 죄악과 허물을 용서한다. 그러나 죄 있는 사람을 결코 죄 없다 하지 않고, {{gender:부모|아버지}}의 죄악을 {{gender:자녀|아들}}에게 갚아 삼 대와 사 대에까지 이르게 한다.'
ko.R: '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 좀처럼 화를 내지 않고 그의 변함없는 사랑은 크다. 그는 악한 일과 반역을 용서한다. 그러나 죄지은 사람을 그냥 내버려 두지는 않는다. {{gender:부모|아버지}}의 죄를 {{gender:자녀|아들}}의 삶에서 다루어 삼 대와 사 대까지 이르게 한다.'

pt.L: '{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} [é] longo de ira e grande em amor leal, que carrega a iniquidade e a rebeldia; mas de modo nenhum inocenta [o culpado], que visita a iniquidade dos pais sobre os filhos, sobre a terceira e sobre a quarta [geração].'
pt.B: '{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é lento para se irar e cheio de amor leal, e perdoa a maldade e a rebeldia. Mas {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} jamais deixa impune o culpado; faz cair a culpa dos pais sobre os filhos, até a terceira e a quarta geração.'
pt.R: '{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} demora a ficar irado, e o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal é grande. Ele perdoa o mal e a rebeldia. Mas {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não deixa o culpado ficar sem castigo. Ele trata do pecado dos pais na vida dos filhos, até a terceira e a quarta geração.'

am.L: “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለቁጣ የዘገየ፣ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ የበዛ፣ በደልንና መተላለፍን የሚሸከም፣ [በደለኛውን] ግን ከቶ ንጹሕ የማያደርግ፣ የአባቶችን በደል በልጆች ላይ እስከ ሦስተኛና እስከ አራተኛ [ትውልድ] የሚያመጣ ነው።”
am.B: “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቶሎ የማይቆጣ፣ በጽኑ ፍቅር የበለጸገ፣ በደልንና ዓመፅን ይቅር የሚል ነው። በደለኛውን ግን ከቶ ንጹሕ ነው አይልም፤ {{gender:የወላጆችን|የአባቶችን}} በደል እስከ ሦስተኛና አራተኛ ትውልድ ድረስ በልጆቻቸው ላይ ያመጣል።”
am.R: “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቶሎ አይቆጣም፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ታላቅ ነው። ክፋትንና ዓመፅን ይቅር ይላል። በደለኛውን ግን ሳይቀጣ አይተውም። {{gender:የወላጆችን|የአባቶችን}} ኃጢአት በልጆቻቸው ሕይወት ላይ እስከ ሦስተኛና አራተኛ ትውልድ ድረስ ያስከትላል።”

decisions.choice: Moses quotes the LORD's own words to him at Sinai (Exodus 34:6-7)
decisions.reason: "As you have spoken" (verse 17) points to the time the LORD passed before Moses and proclaimed his name (Exodus 34:6-7). Moses repeats the heart of it, in a shorter form: he leaves out "compassionate and gracious", "and faithfulness", "keeping steadfast love to thousands" and the third word for sin, and keeps God's patience, his steadfast love, his forgiveness, and his justice. He asks God to act now as he said he is. That proclamation followed the golden calf, when God also forgave a rebellious people (Exodus 32-34).

decisions.choice: long of anger: slow to become angry, patient
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 34:6: anger is pictured as a nose or nostrils that are "long", slow to burn hot. It means patient and slow to punish.

decisions.choice: great of steadfast love: abounding in loyal, faithful love
decisions.reason: The word means kindness and love that stay loyal to a relationship and do not give up, the love of the LORD's covenant with Israel (Exodus 20:6; 34:6). Verse 19 builds the plea on its "greatness".

decisions.choice: bearing iniquity and transgression: forgiving wrongdoing and rebellion
decisions.reason: The verb means to lift and carry; with sin as its object it means to carry it away, to forgive (Exodus 34:7; Psalm 32:1, 5). Iniquity is crooked wrong and the guilt it brings; transgression is rebellion, breaking faith. The same verb returns in verse 19 ("as you have forgiven") and in verses 33-34, where the people will "bear" their own wrong.

decisions.choice: he will by no means acquit: he will certainly not treat the guilty as innocent
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled for emphasis, as in Exodus 34:7: "acquitting, he will not acquit". Its object, the guilty, is understood. Forgiveness does not mean that wrong is treated as though it were never done, which is what happens in verses 20-23: the people are spared, but the guilty generation will not enter the land.

decisions.choice: visiting the iniquity of fathers on children: the effects of sin reach later generations
decisions.reason: To "visit" is to attend to, here to bring the consequences of wrongdoing (Exodus 20:5; 34:7). In this chapter the children of the rebels will share forty years in the wilderness because of their parents (verse 33), and yet will enter the land (verse 31). Each person answers for his own sin (Deuteronomy 24:16; Ezekiel 18:20).

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 34:6, Balanced and Readable say "faithful love" and Literal "steadfast love". Both keep the loyalty in the word, which "love" alone would lose.

decisions.choice: will never acquit the guilty (Balanced); will not let the guilty go free (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 34:7, Balanced and Readable name "the guilty" without brackets and render the doubled verb with "never" or a plain "not".

decisions.choice: deals with the sin of parents in the lives of
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 34:7, Readable says in plain words what "visiting iniquity on" means.

decisions.choice: "lento para la ira" (L), "lento para enojarse" (B), "no se enoja fácilmente" (R); "grande en amor fiel" (L), "rico en amor fiel" (B)
decisions.reason: The words Moses quotes from Exodus 34:6 are worded the same way wherever the formula returns in the Old Testament. "Amor fiel" is the settled term for steadfast love; "misericordia" would be the word for mercy, and "tardo" is archaic.

decisions.choice: "los padres", "los hijos" with no gender span
alternatives: gender spans as in the English
decisions.reason: Spanish "padres" already means parents and "hijos" already includes daughters, so the one wording serves both English options.

decisions.choice: "qui lève la faute" (L); "ne tient nullement [le coupable] pour innocent" (L), "ne déclare jamais innocent le coupable" (B), "ne laisse pas le coupable impuni" (R)
decisions.reason: Moses quotes Exodus 34:6-7, and the French uses the same wording as there. "Porter la faute" would suggest bearing the punishment rather than carrying the wrong away (m4); Balanced and Readable say "pardonne". The doubled verb (m5) is carried by "nullement" and "jamais".

decisions.choice: "mkawivu wa hasira" (L), "huchelewa kukasirika" (B), "hakasiriki upesi" (R); "upendo usiokoma" for steadfast love
decisions.reason: Fresh wording for the formula of Exodus 34:6, used wherever it returns. "Si mwepesi wa hasira, mwingi wa fadhili" is the wording of a copyrighted Swahili Bible; "upendo usiokoma" is the settled term.

decisions.choice: "hamhesabu kamwe [mwenye hatia] kuwa hana hatia" (L); "hamtangazi kamwe mwenye hatia kuwa hana hatia" (B)
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 34:7, which Moses quotes: the doubled verb (m5) means God will never treat or declare the guilty innocent, and "kamwe" carries the emphasis. Readable says "hamwachi mwenye hatia aende huru", as there.

decisions.choice: wording of the Vietnamese Exodus 34:6-7, which Moses quotes
decisions.reason: Moses quotes the LORD's words at Sinai (meaning decision), so each level repeats the words its own level uses there, including the gender span for "fathers" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: Wording kept close to the Korean of Exodus 34:6-7
decisions.reason: Moses quotes the LORD's own words at Sinai (meaning decision), so Korean reuses that passage's terms: "분노를 오래 참고" (L), "한결같은 사랑" (L, B) / "변함없는 사랑" (R) for *ḥesed*, "죄악과 허물", "죄 없다 하지 않고", "갚는다". God speaking of himself is quoted in the plain style, without the honorific.

decisions.choice: {{gender:자녀|아들들}} (L); {{gender:부모|아버지}} ... {{gender:자녀|아들}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: The gender spans follow the English and Exodus 34:7 in Korean; Literal keeps "아버지들" as the English Literal keeps "fathers".

decisions.choice: the wording of Exodus 34:6-7 in Portuguese, phrase for phrase
decisions.reason: Moses quotes the LORD's words at Sinai (m1), so each level repeats the Portuguese of Exodus 34:6-7 wherever the Hebrew is the same: "longo de ira e grande em amor leal", "de modo nenhum inocenta [o culpado]", "visita a iniquidade dos pais sobre os filhos" (L); "lento para se irar e cheio de amor leal", "jamais deixa impune o culpado", "faz cair a culpa dos pais sobre os filhos" (B); "demora a ficar irado", "não deixa o culpado ficar sem castigo", "trata do pecado dos pais na vida dos filhos" (R). What Moses leaves out of the Exodus words (m1) is left out here too. Portuguese "os pais" and "os filhos" already include mothers and daughters, so the English gender spans have no Portuguese counterpart.

decisions.choice: the wording of Exodus 34:6-7 kept where the Hebrew is the same: "ለቁጣ የዘገየ፣ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ የበዛ" (L), "ቶሎ የማይቆጣ፣ በጽኑ ፍቅር የበለጸገ" (B), "ቶሎ አይቆጣም፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ታላቅ ነው" (R)
decisions.reason: Moses quotes the LORD's words at Sinai, so the Amharic reader should hear the same formula; the words Numbers leaves out (faithfulness, sin, grandchildren) are left out here too.

decisions.choice: "በልጆች ላይ" with no gender span at Literal, as Exodus 34:7
decisions.reason: "ልጆች" already includes daughters; Balanced and Readable keep the span on the fathers ("{{gender:የወላጆችን|የአባቶችን}}") as Exodus 34:7 does.

source.text: סְלַֽח־נָ֗א לַעֲוֺ֛ן הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה כְּגֹ֣דֶל חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְכַאֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֨אתָה֙ לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם וְעַד־הֵֽנָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: Forgive please the iniquity of the people the this according to [the] greatness of your steadfast love, and just as you have lifted [it] for the people the this from Egypt and until now.

en.L: Pardon, please, the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} steadfast love, and just as {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have forgiven this people from Egypt and until now."
en.B: Please pardon the wrongdoing of this people, as befits the greatness of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love, just as {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have forgiven this people all the way from Egypt until now."
en.R: Please forgive the sin of these people, because {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love is so great. Forgive them as {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have forgiven them ever since they left Egypt."

es.L: Perdona, por favor, la iniquidad de este pueblo según la grandeza de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel, y así como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has perdonado a este pueblo desde Egipto hasta ahora».
es.B: Te ruego que perdones la maldad de este pueblo, conforme a la grandeza de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel, así como lo has perdonado desde Egipto hasta ahora».
es.R: Por favor, perdona el pecado de esta gente, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel es muy grande. Perdónalos como los has perdonado desde que salieron de Egipto».

fr.L: Pardonne donc la faute de ce peuple selon la grandeur de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle, et comme {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait grâce à ce peuple depuis l’Égypte jusqu’à maintenant. »
fr.B: Pardonne, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en prie, la faute de ce peuple, comme il convient à la grandeur de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle, de même que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait grâce à ce peuple depuis l’Égypte jusqu’à aujourd’hui. »
fr.R: Je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en prie, pardonne le péché de ces gens, parce que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle est si grand. Pardonne-leur comme {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} leur as pardonné depuis qu’ils sont sortis d’Égypte. »

sw.L: Samehe, tafadhali, uovu wa watu hawa kwa kadiri ya ukuu wa upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, kama vile {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umewachukulia watu hawa tangu Misri hadi sasa."
sw.B: Tafadhali usamehe uovu wa watu hawa, kama inavyostahili ukuu wa upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, kama vile ulivyowachukulia watu hawa tangu Misri mpaka sasa."
sw.R: Tafadhali wasamehe watu hawa dhambi yao, kwa sababu upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma ni mkubwa sana. Wasamehe kama ulivyowasamehe tangu walipotoka Misri."

vi.L: Xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tha thứ gian ác của dân này theo sự lớn lao của tình yêu thương thành tín {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tha thứ cho dân này từ Ai Cập cho đến nay."
vi.B: Xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tha thứ tội lỗi của dân này, theo tình yêu thương thành tín lớn lao của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tha thứ cho dân này suốt từ Ai Cập cho đến bây giờ."
vi.R: Xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tha thứ tội lỗi cho dân này, vì tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật lớn lao. Xin tha thứ cho họ như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tha thứ cho họ từ khi họ ra khỏi Ai Cập đến nay."

ko.L: 주님의 한결같은 사랑의 크심을 따라 이 백성의 죄악을 제발 용서해 주십시오. 주님께서 이집트에서부터 지금까지 이 백성을 용서하신 것처럼 [용서해 주십시오]."
ko.B: 주님의 한결같은 사랑이 크시니, 그 사랑에 걸맞게 이 백성의 죄악을 용서해 주십시오. 이집트에서부터 지금까지 주님께서 이 백성을 용서해 오신 것처럼 용서해 주십시오."
ko.R: 주님의 변함없는 사랑은 크시니, 이 백성의 죄를 용서해 주십시오. 그들이 이집트를 떠난 뒤로 지금까지 주님께서 용서해 주신 것처럼 이번에도 용서해 주십시오."

pt.L: Perdoa, por favor, a iniquidade deste povo segundo a grandeza do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal, e assim como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} carregaste [a culpa] deste povo desde o Egito até aqui."
pt.B: Por favor, perdoa a maldade deste povo, conforme a grandeza do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal, assim como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} o tens perdoado desde o Egito até agora."
pt.R: Por favor, perdoa o pecado deste povo, porque o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal é muito grande. Perdoa como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} os tens perdoado desde que saíram do Egito."

am.L: እባክህ፣ እንደ ጽኑ ፍቅርህ ታላቅነት፣ ከግብፅ ጀምሮ እስከ አሁን ድረስ ለዚህ ሕዝብ ይቅር እንዳልህ፣ የዚህን ሕዝብ በደል ይቅር በል።»

decisions.choice: pardon: forgive, the forgiveness that only God gives
decisions.reason: This verb for forgiving is used in the Old Testament only with God as the one who forgives (Exodus 34:9; Leviticus 4:20). The LORD answers with the same verb in verse 20.

decisions.choice: as you have forgiven: literally "lifted" or "borne"
decisions.reason: This is the verb of verse 18, "bearing iniquity". Moses asks God to go on doing what he has done since the exodus, at the sea, with the manna, after the golden calf (Exodus 32:14; 34:9-10).

decisions.choice: according to the greatness of your steadfast love: the measure and ground of the request
decisions.reason: Moses does not appeal to anything in the people but to the size of God's own love, which he has just named (verse 18).

decisions.choice: pardon ... forgiven
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced use "pardon" for the first verb and "forgive" for the second, so the two Hebrew verbs are kept apart. Readable says "forgive" for both.

decisions.choice: "perdonar" for both verbs
decisions.reason: The English keeps "pardon" and "forgive" apart at Literal and Balanced. Spanish has no second everyday verb for forgiving: "absolver" would echo the "absuelve" of verse 18, which renders a different Hebrew verb (acquit), and "soportar" says only "put up with". The meaning decisions say which Hebrew verb is which.

decisions.choice: "Pardonne" ... "tu as fait grâce à"
decisions.reason: As the English does with "pardon" and "forgive", Literal and Balanced keep the two Hebrew verbs apart; Readable says "pardonner" for both.

decisions.choice: "samehe" ... "umewachukulia" (you have borne with them)
decisions.reason: "Kuchukulia" is the second Hebrew verb's picture of carrying, and in Swahili it means to bear with and forgive someone; it keeps the two verbs apart as the English does. Readable says "kusamehe" for both.

decisions.choice: "tha thứ" for both pardon and forgiven ("lifted")
decisions.reason: Vietnamese has one common verb for the forgiveness God gives; the meaning decision notes that the second verb is literally "lifted", which Vietnamese cannot keep without obscuring the sense.

decisions.choice: "용서하다" for both verbs
decisions.reason: The first verb is the forgiveness only God gives, the second literally "lifted" (meaning decisions); Korean uses the one plain word "용서하다" for both, as Leviticus 4:20 does in Korean.

decisions.choice: Perdoa ... carregaste [a culpa] (L); perdoa ... tens perdoado (B, R)
decisions.reason: The English Literal and Balanced keep two Hebrew verbs apart with "pardon" and "forgive" (r-en-1); Portuguese has one plain verb, "perdoar", and no second word that does not sound legal ("absolver", "indultar"). Literal shows the second verb by its root sense, "carregar", which links it to "carrega a iniquidade" in verse 18 (m2); Balanced and Readable say "perdoar" for both.

decisions.choice: pardoned them, as you asked

decisions.choice: as I live: a solemn oath
decisions.reason: People swore "as the LORD lives"; God, having no one greater to swear by, swears by his own life (verse 28; Deuteronomy 32:40; Isaiah 49:18). What follows is certain.

decisions.choice: and as all the earth will be filled with the glory of the LORD: part of the oath
alternatives: as I live, all the earth will be filled with the glory of the LORD
decisions.reason: The clause can be read as a second thing God swears by, as sure as his own life: his glory will fill the earth. It can also be read as the first thing he swears to: "as I live, all the earth will be filled with my glory". Either way, his glory will be known everywhere, the very thing Moses feared would be lost (verses 13-16), even though this generation will not enter the land.

decisions.choice: the glory of the LORD filling the earth
decisions.reason: The same hope is sung in Psalm 72:19 and promised in Isaiah 6:3 and Habakkuk 2:14.

decisions.choice: ends with a comma
decisions.reason: The oath runs on through verses 22-23, so Literal and Balanced end with a comma. Readable closes the oath formula with a colon and gives what is sworn in the next verses.

decisions.choice: I make this promise
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly that this is an oath.

decisions.choice: "thật như Ta hằng sống" for the oath "as I live"
alternatives: "Ta chỉ sự sống Ta mà thề"
decisions.reason: A solemn oath (meaning decision); "thật như ... hằng sống" is the Vietnamese form of an oath by one's life and is used again in verse 28.

decisions.choice: The oath runs on into verses 22-23 with a comma
decisions.reason: As the English, the oath (meaning decisions) is one sentence across verses 21-23; Korean keeps each verse's content after its marker by ending this verse with "-이니," / "-만큼,", and Readable states it as a promise, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: tão certo como eu vivo
decisions.reason: For the whole book: God's oath by his own life (m1) is "tão certo como eu vivo", the Portuguese formula for an oath that what follows will happen; Literal brackets the words the Hebrew lacks. Verse 28 uses the same words.

ko.L: 내 영광과 내가 이집트와 광야에서 행한 내 표적들을 보고도, 이렇게 열 번이나 나를 시험하고 내 목소리를 듣지 않은 사람들은 모두,
ko.B: 내 영광과 내가 이집트와 광야에서 행한 표적들을 보고도, 이렇게 열 번이나 나를 시험하며 내 목소리를 듣지 않은 사람들은 모두,
ko.R: 이 사람들은 모두 내 영광을 보았다. 내가 이집트와 광야에서 행한 놀라운 일들도 보았다. 그런데도 그들은 이렇게 열 번이나 나를 시험했고, 내 말을 따르지 않았다.

pt.L: que todos os homens que viram a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} glória e os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} sinais que fiz no Egito e no deserto, e {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} puseram à prova estas dez vezes, e não ouviram a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} voz,
pt.B: todos os homens que viram a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} glória e os sinais que fiz no Egito e no deserto, e mesmo assim {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} puseram à prova estas dez vezes e não deram ouvidos à {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} voz,
pt.R: Todos esses homens viram a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} glória. Eles viram os milagres que fiz no Egito e no deserto. Mesmo assim, já {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} puseram à prova dez vezes e não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} obedeceram.

am.L: ክብሬንና በግብፅና በምድረ በዳ ያደረግኋቸውን ምልክቶቼን ያዩ፣ እነዚህንም አሥር ጊዜ የፈተኑኝ፣ ቃሌንም ያልሰሙ ሰዎች ሁሉ፣
am.B: ክብሬንና በግብፅና በምድረ በዳ ያደረግኋቸውን ምልክቶች ያዩ፣ ሆኖም እነዚህን አሥር ጊዜ የፈተኑኝና ቃሌን ያልሰሙ ሰዎች ሁሉ፣
am.R: እነዚህ ሰዎች ሁሉ ክብሬን አይተዋል። በግብፅና በምድረ በዳ ያደረግኋቸውን ተአምራት አይተዋል። ሆኖም እነዚህን አሥር ጊዜ ፈተኑኝ፤ አልታዘዙኝምም።

decisions.choice: tested me: put God to the proof, demanded that he show himself again
decisions.reason: To test God is to doubt him and demand proof that he is with them, as at Massah (Exodus 17:2, 7; Psalm 95:8-9). After all they had seen, they still refused to trust him.

decisions.choice: these ten times: again and again
decisions.reason: "Ten times" may be a round number for many times, as in Genesis 31:7. It may also count the people's acts of testing since leaving Egypt, at the sea, at Marah, with the manna and the water, the golden calf, and in Numbers 11-14.

decisions.choice: the men: the generation that rejected the land
decisions.reason: The men meant are those counted in the census, twenty years old and upward (verse 29). The sentence that begins here finds its verb in verse 23.

decisions.choice: listened to my voice: obeyed
decisions.reason: To "listen to the voice" of someone is to obey them (Exodus 19:5).

decisions.choice: ends with a comma
decisions.reason: The sentence continues in verse 23. Readable breaks it into sentences of its own.

decisions.choice: obeyed me
decisions.reason: Readable says what "listened to my voice" means.

decisions.choice: "thử" (L); "thử thách" (B, R) for tested
decisions.reason: To put God to the proof (meaning decision), as the Vietnamese Exodus 17:2 says; "cám dỗ" would mean tempting to sin.

source.text: אִם־יִרְאוּ֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖עְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָ֑ם וְכָל־מְנַאֲצַ֖י לֹ֥א יִרְאֽוּהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: surely not will they see the land which I swore to their fathers, and all those despising me will not see it.

en.L: surely they will not see the land which I swore to their fathers, and all who despised {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} will not see it.
en.B: not one of them will see the land I swore to give their fathers; none of those who scorned {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} will see it.
en.R: Not one of them will ever see the land I promised their ancestors with an oath. No one who has treated {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} with contempt will see it.

es.L: ciertamente no verán la tierra que juré a sus padres, y todos los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} despreciaron no la verán.
es.B: ninguno de ellos verá la tierra que juré dar a sus padres; ninguno de los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} menospreciaron la verá.
es.R: Ninguno de ellos verá jamás la tierra que prometí con juramento a sus antepasados. Nadie que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} haya despreciado la verá.

fr.L: certainement ils ne verront pas le pays que j’ai juré à leurs pères, et tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont méprisé ne le verront pas.
fr.B: aucun d’eux ne verra le pays que j’ai juré de donner à leurs pères ; aucun de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont traité avec mépris ne le verra.
fr.R: Aucun d’eux ne verra jamais le pays que j’ai promis par serment à leurs ancêtres. Personne parmi ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont méprisé ne le verra.

sw.L: hakika hawataiona nchi niliyowaapia baba zao, na wote walionidharau hawataiona.
sw.B: hakuna hata mmoja wao atakayeiona nchi niliyoapa kuwapa baba zao; hakuna yeyote kati ya walionidharau atakayeiona.
sw.R: Hakuna hata mmoja wao atakayeiona kamwe nchi niliyowaahidi mababu zao kwa kiapo. Hakuna mtu aliyenidharau atakayeiona.

vi.L: chắc chắn họ sẽ không thấy xứ mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thề với tổ phụ họ, và tất cả những kẻ khinh dể {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không thấy nó.
vi.B: thì không một ai trong họ sẽ thấy xứ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thề ban cho tổ phụ họ; không một kẻ nào đã khinh dể {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ được thấy xứ ấy.
vi.R: Không một ai trong họ sẽ được thấy xứ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thề hứa ban cho tổ tiên họ. Không một kẻ nào coi thường {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ được thấy xứ ấy.

ko.L: 내가 그들의 조상들에게 맹세한 땅을 결코 보지 못할 것이다. 그리고 나를 멸시한 자는 아무도 그것을 보지 못할 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 그들의 조상들에게 주겠다고 맹세한 땅을 결코 보지 못할 것이다. 나를 업신여긴 자는 하나도 그 땅을 보지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 그들 가운데 아무도 내가 그들의 조상들에게 맹세하며 약속한 땅을 보지 못할 것이다. 나를 무시한 사람은 아무도 그 땅을 보지 못할 것이다.

pt.L: certamente não verão a terra que jurei aos seus pais, e todos os que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} desprezaram não a verão.
pt.B: nenhum deles verá a terra que jurei dar aos seus pais; nenhum dos que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} trataram com desprezo a verá.
pt.R: Nenhum deles vai ver a terra que prometi com juramento aos seus antepassados. Ninguém que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} desrespeitou vai vê-la.

am.L: ለአባቶቻቸው የማልሁላቸውን ምድር በእርግጥ አያዩም፤ የናቁኝም ሁሉ አያዩአትም።
am.B: ለአባቶቻቸው ልሰጥ የማልሁትን ምድር ከእነርሱ አንዱም አያይም፤ ከናቁኝም አንድ ስንኳ አያያትም።
am.R: ለአባቶቻቸው በመሐላ ቃል የገባሁላቸውን ምድር ከእነርሱ አንዱም ፈጽሞ አያይም። የናቀኝ ማንም አያያትም።

decisions.choice: surely they will not see: the content of the oath
decisions.reason: In an oath the word "if" stands for a strong "not": "if they see" means "may it be so if they see", that is, they will certainly not see. God swore to give the land to their fathers (Genesis 50:24; Exodus 33:1); now he swears that this generation will not enter it.

decisions.choice: those who despised me: the same word as verse 11
decisions.reason: The verb is the "despise" of verse 11. Their refusal of the land was contempt for the LORD who gave it.

decisions.choice: swore to give their fathers / promised their ancestors with an oath
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "to give" or "promised", which the oath about the land means.

decisions.choice: scorned (Balanced); treated with contempt (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 11.

source.text: וְעַבְדִּ֣י כָלֵ֗ב עֵ֣קֶב הָֽיְתָ֞ה ר֤וּחַ אַחֶ֨רֶת֙ עִמּ֔וֹ וַיְמַלֵּ֖א אַחֲרָ֑י וַהֲבִֽיאֹתִ֗יו אֶל־הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֣א שָׁ֔מָּה וְזַרְע֖וֹ יוֹרִשֶֽׁנָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: But my servant Caleb, because was a spirit other with him and he filled after me, and I will bring him into the land where he went to there, and his offspring will possess it.

en.L: But {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} slave Caleb, because there was another spirit with him and he fully followed after {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, I will bring him into the land where he went, and his offspring will take possession of it.
en.B: But {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant Caleb is different: there is another spirit in him, and he has followed {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} with all his heart. So I will bring him into the land that he entered, and his descendants will take possession of it.
en.R: But {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant Caleb has a different attitude. He has followed {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} with all his heart. So I will bring him into the land he explored, and his descendants will own it.

es.L: Pero {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} esclavo Caleb, porque hubo otro espíritu con él y fue en pos de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} plenamente, lo llevaré a la tierra adonde fue, y su descendencia la poseerá.
es.B: Pero {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo Caleb es distinto: hay en él otro espíritu, y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha seguido de todo corazón. Por eso lo llevaré a la tierra en la que entró, y sus descendientes la poseerán.
es.R: Pero {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo Caleb tiene una actitud diferente. Me ha seguido de todo corazón. Por eso lo llevaré a la tierra que exploró, y sus descendientes serán sus dueños.

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} esclave Caleb, parce qu’il y a eu un autre esprit avec lui et qu’il a pleinement marché après {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je le ferai entrer dans le pays où il est allé, et sa descendance en prendra possession.
fr.B: Mais {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur Caleb est différent : il y a en lui un autre esprit, et il {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a suivi de tout son cœur. Je le ferai donc entrer dans le pays où il est allé, et ses descendants en prendront possession.
fr.R: Mais {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur Caleb a une autre attitude. Il {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a suivi de tout son cœur. Alors je le ferai entrer dans le pays qu’il a exploré, et ses descendants le posséderont.

sw.L: Lakini mtumwa {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Kalebu, kwa sababu kulikuwa na roho nyingine pamoja naye, naye amenifuata kikamilifu, nitamwingiza katika nchi aliyoiendea, na uzao wake utaimiliki.
sw.B: Lakini mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Kalebu ni tofauti: ana roho nyingine ndani yake, naye amenifuata kwa moyo wake wote. Kwa hiyo nitamwingiza katika nchi aliyoiingia, na wazao wake wataimiliki.
sw.R: Lakini mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Kalebu ana moyo tofauti. Amenifuata kwa moyo wake wote. Kwa hiyo nitamleta katika nchi aliyoipeleleza, na wazao wake wataimiliki.

vi.L: Nhưng đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Ca-lép, vì người có một tâm thần khác và đã theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trọn vẹn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem người vào xứ người đã đi đến, và dòng dõi người sẽ chiếm hữu nó.
vi.B: Nhưng Ca-lép, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, thì khác: người có một tâm thần khác và đã hết lòng theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem người vào xứ người đã đặt chân đến, và dòng dõi người sẽ chiếm hữu xứ ấy.
vi.R: Nhưng Ca-lép, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, có một thái độ khác. Người đã hết lòng theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đưa người vào xứ người đã đi xem xét, và con cháu người sẽ làm chủ xứ ấy.

ko.L: 그러나 내 종 갈렙은 그에게 다른 영이 있고 그가 나를 온전히 따랐으므로, 내가 그를 그가 갔던 그 땅으로 데려가겠다. 그리고 그의 자손이 그 땅을 차지할 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 내 종 갈렙은 다르다. 그에게는 다른 마음이 있고, 그는 온 마음으로 나를 따랐다. 그래서 내가 그를 그가 들어가 보았던 땅으로 데려가겠다. 그의 자손이 그 땅을 차지할 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 내 종 갈렙은 생각이 다르다. 그는 온 마음으로 나를 따랐다. 그래서 내가 그를 그가 살펴본 땅으로 데려가겠다. 그의 자손이 그 땅을 갖게 될 것이다.

pt.L: Mas o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} escravo Calebe, porque houve outro espírito com ele e ele {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} seguiu inteiramente, eu o farei entrar na terra aonde ele foi, e a sua descendência tomará posse dela.
pt.B: Mas o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo Calebe é diferente: há nele outro espírito, e ele {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} seguiu de todo o coração. Por isso eu o levarei para a terra em que ele entrou, e os seus descendentes tomarão posse dela.
pt.R: Mas o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo Calebe tem uma atitude diferente. Ele {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} seguiu de todo o coração. Por isso vou levá-lo para a terra que ele explorou, e os seus descendentes serão donos dela.

am.L: ባሪያዬ ካሌብ ግን ሌላ መንፈስ ከእርሱ ጋር ስለ ነበረና ፈጽሞ ስለ ተከተለኝ፣ ወደ ሄደባት ምድር አገባዋለሁ፤ ዘሩም ይወርሳታል።
am.B: አገልጋዬ ካሌብ ግን የተለየ ነው፤ በእርሱ ሌላ መንፈስ አለ፤ በፍጹም ልቡም ተከትሎኛል። ስለዚህ ወደ ገባባት ምድር አገባዋለሁ፤ ዘሩም ይወርሳታል።
am.R: አገልጋዬ ካሌብ ግን የተለየ አስተሳሰብ አለው። በፍጹም ልቡ ተከትሎኛል። ስለዚህ ወደ ቃኛት ምድር አገባዋለሁ፤ ዘሮቹም የራሳቸው ያደርጓታል።

decisions.choice: my servant: one who belongs to the LORD and serves him
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for a slave, a person owned by a master, not hired. Said by God, "my servant" is a title of honor for one who belongs to him and does his will, as Moses is called (12:7-8; Exodus 14:31).

decisions.choice: another spirit was with him: a different attitude and outlook
decisions.reason: "Spirit" here means a person's inner disposition, the attitude that moves him (Genesis 41:8; Ezekiel 11:19). Caleb's trust in God made him unlike the others, who spread fear (13:30-33).

decisions.choice: he filled after me: he followed me fully
decisions.reason: "To fill after" someone is to follow them completely, holding nothing back. The phrase is used of Caleb and Joshua again and again (32:11-12; Deuteronomy 1:36; Joshua 14:8-9, 14).

decisions.choice: I will bring him into the land where he went: the promise of Hebron
decisions.reason: Caleb had gone through the land as far as Hebron (13:22). Joshua 14:6-14 tells how he received it for his family, as Moses promised. Joshua is named with Caleb in verses 30 and 38.

decisions.choice: slave
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "slave" for this word, as the style of this translation does; Balanced and Readable say "servant", since the point is belonging to God and serving him, not modern slavery.

decisions.choice: a different attitude
decisions.reason: Readable says what "another spirit" means; it is not God's Spirit here but Caleb's own spirit.

decisions.choice: "ana moyo tofauti" (he has a different heart)
decisions.reason: Readable says what "another spirit" means, as the English "a different attitude" does. In Swahili "moyo" is the everyday word for a person's inner disposition, and it avoids "roho", which readers may take as God's Spirit.

decisions.choice: "một tâm thần khác" (L, B); "một thái độ khác" (R)
decisions.reason: A different attitude and outlook (meaning decision); "tâm thần" keeps the word spirit as an inner disposition, Readable says "thái độ".

decisions.choice: "đầy tớ Ta" at every level; God speaks of Caleb as "người"
decisions.reason: As in 12:7, the Genesis terms note keeps "nô lệ" for slavery itself; "người" is the neutral way for God to speak of a man he approves.

decisions.choice: "다른 영" (L); "다른 마음" (B); "생각이 다르다" (R)
decisions.reason: The idiom means a different attitude and outlook (meaning decision); Literal keeps "영", and Balanced and Readable avoid a word that could be read as a different spirit being.

source.text: וְהָֽעֲמָלֵקִ֥י וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּעֵ֑מֶק מָחָ֗ר פְּנ֨וּ וּסְע֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם הַמִּדְבָּ֖ר דֶּ֥רֶךְ יַם־סֽוּף׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And the Amalekite and the Canaanite [are] dwelling in the valley. Tomorrow turn and set out for yourselves [to] the wilderness, [the] way of [the] Sea of Reed[s].

en.L: And the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley. Tomorrow turn and set out into the wilderness [by] the way of the Sea of Reeds."
en.B: Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites live in the valley. Tomorrow turn around and set out into the wilderness along the road to the Red Sea."
en.R: The Amalekites and the Canaanites live in the valley. So tomorrow turn around and go back into the desert, toward the Red Sea."

es.L: Y el amalecita y el cananeo habitan en el valle. Mañana {{plural_you:vuélvanse|volveos}} y {{plural_you:partan|partid}} hacia el desierto, [por] el camino del mar de los Juncos».

decisions.choice: the Amalekites and Canaanites live in the valley: the reason Israel must turn back now
decisions.reason: The clause explains the command that follows: the way ahead is held by these peoples, and without the LORD Israel cannot go that way. The "valley" is probably the lower land between the wilderness and the hill country. In 13:29 the Amalekites live in the Negev and the Canaanites by the sea and the Jordan; in verses 43-45 both peoples meet Israel in the hill country.

decisions.choice: the way of the Sea of Reeds: the road toward the gulf to the southeast
decisions.reason: The name is the one used for the sea of the crossing (Exodus 13:18; 15:4), known as the Red Sea. Here it most likely means the road toward the gulf east of Sinai, by Ezion-geber (Deuteronomy 1:40; 2:1; 1 Kings 9:26). Israel is sent back the way it came, away from the land.

decisions.choice: turn and set out: the journey into the land is reversed
decisions.reason: Israel had come to the edge of the land (13:26). Now the LORD sends them back into the wilderness, where the generation that refused will die (verses 29-35). Deuteronomy 1:40 recalls the command.

decisions.choice: the Red Sea
decisions.reason: As in Exodus, Literal says "Sea of Reeds", the meaning of the name, and Balanced and Readable "the Red Sea", the name English readers know.

decisions.choice: the Amalekites and the Canaanites
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses the singular for each people ("the Amalekite"). Balanced and Readable use the plural, as English does.

decisions.choice: "갈대 바다" (L); "홍해" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet: the English Literal says "the Sea of Reeds", so Literal gives the Hebrew name in Korean; Balanced and Readable use the familiar "홍해", as Exodus 13:18 does.

decisions.choice: "Biển Sậy" (L); "Biển Đỏ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal follows the English Literal's "Sea of Reeds" with "Biển Sậy", the name the Vietnamese Joshua uses; Balanced and Readable use the familiar name.

decisions.choice: God addresses the people as "các ngươi" at every level in 14:25-35
decisions.reason: These are words of judgment on the whole rebellious generation; the distance of "các ngươi" fits them at every level, where "các con" would sound tender.

decisions.choice: o mar dos Juncos (L); o mar Vermelho (B, R); vocês (virem-se, partam)
decisions.reason: The sea's name is said as Exodus 13:18 says it in Portuguese (m2). The commands are plural in the Hebrew, for Moses and the people, so God's "tu" to Moses gives way here to "vocês".

decisions.choice: "የሸምበቆ ባሕር" (Sea of Reeds) at Literal; "ቀይ ባሕር" (the Red Sea) at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Literal keeps what the Hebrew name says, as the English Literal does; the other levels use the name Amharic readers know for the sea and the gulf the road leads to.

records.literal_gloss: Until when to the congregation the evil the this who they [are] grumbling against me? The grumblings of [the] sons of Israel which they [are] grumbling against me I have heard.

en.L: "How long [shall I bear] with this evil congregation who are grumbling against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}? The grumblings of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, which they are grumbling against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, I have heard.
en.B: "How long must I put up with this evil congregation that keeps grumbling against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}? I have heard the complaints the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} are making against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.R: "How long must I put up with this evil community? They keep complaining against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. I have heard all the complaints the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} are making against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: «¿Hasta cuándo [he de soportar] a esta comunidad malvada que murmura contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}? Las murmuraciones de los hijos de Israel, con que murmuran contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, las he oído.
es.B: «¿Hasta cuándo tendré que aguantar a esta comunidad malvada que no deja de murmurar contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}? He oído las quejas que los israelitas lanzan contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.
es.R: «¿Hasta cuándo tendré que soportar a esta comunidad malvada? No dejan de quejarse contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. He oído todas las quejas que los israelitas tienen contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.

fr.L: « Jusqu’à quand [supporterai-je] cette communauté mauvaise qui murmure contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ? Les murmures des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël, qu’ils murmurent contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je les ai entendus.
fr.B: « Jusqu’à quand devrai-je supporter cette communauté mauvaise qui ne cesse de murmurer contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ? J’ai entendu les plaintes que les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} profèrent contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.R: « Jusqu’à quand vais-je devoir supporter cette communauté mauvaise ? Ils n’arrêtent pas de se plaindre contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. J’ai entendu toutes les plaintes que les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} font contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.

sw.L: "Hadi lini [nitaivumilia] jumuiya hii ovu inayoninung'unikia? Manung'uniko ya wana wa Israeli wanayoninung'unikia, nimeyasikia.
sw.B: "Nitaivumilia mpaka lini jumuiya hii ovu isiyoacha kuninung'unikia? Nimeyasikia malalamiko ambayo Waisraeli wanatoa dhidi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.R: "Nitaivumilia mpaka lini jumuiya hii mbaya? Hawaachi kunilalamikia. Nimesikia malalamiko yote ambayo Waisraeli wanatoa dhidi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.

vi.L: "[Ta phải chịu] hội chúng gian ác này lằm bằm chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cho đến bao giờ? Những lời lằm bằm của con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên, mà chúng lằm bằm chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã nghe rồi.
vi.B: "Ta phải chịu đựng hội chúng gian ác này, là bọn cứ lằm bằm chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, cho đến bao giờ? Ta đã nghe những lời than phiền mà dân Y-sơ-ra-ên lằm bằm chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: "Ta phải chịu đựng đám dân gian ác này đến bao giờ? Chúng cứ phàn nàn chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta đã nghe hết những lời phàn nàn của dân Y-sơ-ra-ên chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: "나를 원망하는 이 악한 회중을 언제까지 [참아야 하겠느냐]? 이스라엘 자손이 나를 원망하는 그 원망을 내가 들었다.
ko.B: "나를 원망하는 이 악한 회중을 내가 언제까지 참아야 하겠느냐? 이스라엘 백성이 나에게 불평하는 소리를 내가 들었다.
ko.R: "이 악한 무리를 내가 언제까지 참아야 하느냐? 그들은 끊임없이 나에게 불평한다. 이스라엘 사람들이 나에게 하는 불평을 내가 다 들었다.

pt.L: "Até quando [suportarei] esta comunidade má, que murmura contra {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}? As murmurações dos filhos de Israel, que eles murmuram contra {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, eu ouvi.
pt.B: "Até quando terei de suportar esta comunidade má, que vive reclamando contra {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}? Eu ouvi as queixas que os israelitas fazem contra {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.
pt.R: "Até quando vou ter de suportar esta comunidade má? Eles vivem reclamando contra {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. Eu ouvi todas as queixas que os israelitas fazem contra {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.

am.L: «በእኔ ላይ የሚያጉረመርመውን ይህን ክፉ ማኅበር እስከ መቼ [እታገሣለሁ]? የእስራኤል ልጆች በእኔ ላይ የሚያጉረመርሙትን ማጉረምረም ሰምቻለሁ።
am.B: «በእኔ ላይ ዘወትር የሚያጉረመርመውን ይህን ክፉ ማኅበር እስከ መቼ እታገሣለሁ? የእስራኤል ልጆች በእኔ ላይ የሚያሰሙትን ማጉረምረም ሰምቻለሁ።
am.R: «ይህን ክፉ ማኅበር እስከ መቼ እታገሣለሁ? ዘወትር በእኔ ላይ ያጉረመርማሉ። እስራኤላውያን በእኔ ላይ የሚያሰሙትን ማጉረምረም ሁሉ ሰምቻለሁ።

decisions.choice: how long with this evil congregation: an unfinished question
alternatives: How long will this evil congregation grumble against me?
decisions.reason: The Hebrew leaves out the verb: "How long ... to this evil congregation?" The sense is "How long must I bear with them?" (compare verse 11). Some take the verb from the next clause: "How long will this congregation grumble?" The meaning hardly differs.

decisions.choice: evil: wicked, set against the LORD
decisions.reason: The congregation is called evil because it has turned against the LORD; the same words return in verse 35. The "bad" report of the land in verse 37 is the same word.

decisions.choice: grumbling, grumblings: bitter complaint
decisions.reason: The verb of verse 2 and its noun are repeated three times. The LORD has heard every word, and in verse 28 he takes them at their word.

decisions.choice: [shall I bear] / must I put up with
decisions.reason: Every level supplies the missing verb; Literal shows it in brackets.

fr.R: Dis-leur : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit : Aussi vrai que je suis vivant, je vais vous donner exactement ce que vous avez réclamé devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} :

sw.L: Waambie, 'Kama niishivyo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hakika kama mlivyosema masikioni {{deity_pronoun:mwangu|Mwangu}}, ndivyo nitakavyowatendea:
sw.B: Waambie, 'Kama niishivyo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitawatendea sawasawa na mlivyosema nikisikia:
sw.R: Waambie, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema: Hakika kama niishivyo, nitawapa kile kile nilichowasikia mkisema mnakitaka:

vi.L: Hãy nói với chúng: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: [Thật như] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hằng sống, chắc chắn như các ngươi đã nói vào tai {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho các ngươi như vậy:
vi.B: Hãy nói với chúng: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Thật như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hằng sống, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đối xử với các ngươi đúng như những lời các ngươi đã nói cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nghe:
vi.R: Hãy bảo chúng: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Thật như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hằng sống, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho các ngươi đúng điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã nghe các ngươi nói là các ngươi muốn:

ko.L: 그들에게 말하여라. '내가 살아 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말이다. 너희가 내 귀에 말한 그대로 내가 너희에게 반드시 행하겠다.
ko.B: 그들에게 전하여라. '내가 살아 있는 한, 너희가 내 귀에 대고 말한 그대로 내가 너희에게 해 주겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말이다.
ko.R: 그들에게 이렇게 전하여라. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 내가 살아 있는 것이 확실한 것처럼, 너희가 바라던 그대로 내가 너희에게 해 주겠다. 나는 너희가 하는 말을 다 들었다.

pt.L: Dize-lhes: '[Tão certo como] eu vivo, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, certamente como vocês falaram aos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} ouvidos, assim farei a vocês:
pt.B: Dize-lhes: 'Tão certo como eu vivo, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, eu farei a vocês exatamente o que vocês disseram aos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} ouvidos:
pt.R: Diz a eles: '{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} diz: tão certo como eu vivo, vou dar a vocês exatamente o que eu ouvi vocês dizerem que queriam:

am.L: እንዲህ በላቸው፦ “እኔ ሕያው [እንደ ሆንኩ]፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ በጆሮዬ እንደ ተናገራችሁ በእርግጥ እንዲሁ አደርግባችኋለሁ፦
am.B: እንዲህ በላቸው፦ “እኔ ሕያው እንደ ሆንኩ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ በጆሮዬ እንደ ተናገራችሁት አደርግባችኋለሁ፦
am.R: እንዲህ በላቸው፦ “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ እኔ ሕያው እንደ ሆንኩ፣ ስትመኙ እንደ ሰማኋችሁ እንዲሁ አደርግባችኋለሁ፦

decisions.choice: as I live, declares the LORD: a solemn oath
decisions.reason: As in verse 21. "Declares the LORD" (literally "the utterance of the LORD") marks the words as the LORD's own solemn statement.

decisions.choice: as you have spoken in my ears, so I will do: the people get the death they wished for
decisions.reason: The people said, "If only we had died in this wilderness" (verse 2). God takes them at their word: in this wilderness they will die (verse 29). They also said their children would become plunder (verse 3); God answers that too (verse 31).

decisions.choice: surely: the oath word
decisions.reason: The words "if not" in an oath mean "surely": what follows will certainly happen. Compare verse 23, where "if" means "surely not".

decisions.choice: ends with a colon
decisions.reason: What God will do is set out in verses 29-35, so the sentence ends with a colon. The message to the people runs to the end of verse 35.

decisions.choice: "Diles" (singular)
decisions.reason: The speech is to Moses and Aaron, but the Hebrew command "say" is singular, addressed to Moses; Spanish, which must choose, follows the Hebrew. The plural you of the message itself (the people) takes the plural_you setting.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA phán:" placed before the oath
alternatives: "... lời CHÚA phán" after the oath
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sets "declares the LORD" inside the oath; Vietnamese puts the speaker first, as a quotation is introduced, so the oath itself reads without interruption.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말이다" for "declares the LORD"
decisions.reason: God speaks of himself, so his own oath formula takes no honorific; the people hear God's message in 해라체 with 너희, as God speaks in Genesis and Exodus.

decisions.choice: Dize-lhes / Diz a eles (tu) ... vocês
decisions.reason: The command "Say" is singular in the Hebrew, to Moses, though verse 26 names Moses and Aaron, so it keeps God's "tu"; the message itself speaks to the whole people with "vocês" through verse 35.

source.text: בַּמִּדְבָּ֣ר הַ֠זֶּה יִפְּל֨וּ פִגְרֵיכֶ֜ם וְכָל־פְּקֻדֵיכֶם֙ לְכָל־מִסְפַּרְכֶ֔ם מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲלִֽינֹתֶ֖ם עָלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: In the wilderness the this will fall your corpses, and all your counted [ones] according to all your number, from [a] son of twenty year[s] and upward, who have grumbled against me.

en.L: In this wilderness your corpses will fall, all your enrolled [ones] according to all your number, from twenty years old and upward, who have grumbled against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.B: Here in this wilderness your bodies will fall, all of you who were enrolled, the whole number of you from twenty years old and upward, who have grumbled against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.R: Your dead bodies will lie in this desert. Every one of you who was counted, everyone twenty years old or older who complained against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, will die.

es.L: En este desierto caerán {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} cadáveres, todos {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} registrados según todo {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} número, de veinte años para arriba, los que {{plural_you:han murmurado|habéis murmurado}} contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.
es.B: Aquí, en este desierto, caerán {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} cuerpos, todos los que {{plural_you:fueron censados|fuisteis censados}}, el número completo de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} de veinte años para arriba, que {{plural_you:han murmurado|habéis murmurado}} contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Sus|Vuestros}} cadáveres quedarán tendidos en este desierto. Cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} que fue contado, todo el que tenga veinte años o más y se haya quejado contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, morirá.

fr.L: Dans ce désert tomberont vos cadavres, tous vos recensés selon tout votre nombre, de vingt ans et au-dessus, [vous] qui avez murmuré contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.B: Ici, dans ce désert, vos corps tomberont, vous tous qui avez été recensés, vous tous, depuis l’âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, qui avez murmuré contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.R: Vos cadavres vont rester dans ce désert. Vous tous qui avez été comptés, vous qui avez vingt ans ou plus et qui vous êtes plaints contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, vous allez mourir.

sw.L: Katika nyika hii maiti zenu zitaanguka, wote mliohesabiwa kwa kadiri ya hesabu yenu yote, tangu wenye umri wa miaka ishirini na zaidi, mlioninung'unikia.
sw.B: Hapa katika nyika hii miili yenu itaanguka, ninyi nyote mliohesabiwa, idadi yenu yote ya wenye umri wa miaka ishirini na zaidi, mlioninung'unikia.
sw.R: Maiti zenu zitabaki katika jangwa hili. Kila mmoja wenu aliyehesabiwa, kila mwenye umri wa miaka ishirini au zaidi aliyenilalamikia, atakufa.

vi.L: Thây các ngươi sẽ ngã trong hoang mạc này, tất cả những người trong các ngươi đã được kiểm tra theo trọn số của các ngươi, từ hai mươi tuổi trở lên, là những kẻ đã lằm bằm chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Chính trong hoang mạc này, xác các ngươi sẽ ngã xuống, tất cả những ai trong các ngươi đã được kiểm tra dân số, trọn số các ngươi từ hai mươi tuổi trở lên, là những kẻ đã lằm bằm chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Xác các ngươi sẽ nằm lại trong hoang mạc này. Mọi người trong các ngươi đã được kiểm tra dân số, mọi người từ hai mươi tuổi trở lên đã phàn nàn chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, đều sẽ chết.

ko.L: 이 광야에 너희의 시체가 쓰러질 것이다. 너희 가운데 계수된 자, 곧 너희의 모든 수대로 스무 살 이상으로 나를 원망한 자는 모두 [그러할 것이다].
ko.B: 바로 이 광야에서 너희의 시체가 쓰러질 것이다. 너희 가운데 인구 조사에서 계수된 사람, 스무 살 이상으로 나를 원망한 사람은 모두 그렇게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 너희는 이 광야에서 죽어 시체가 될 것이다. 인구 조사 때 계수된 사람, 곧 스무 살 이상으로 나에게 불평한 사람은 모두 죽을 것이다.

pt.L: Neste deserto cairão os cadáveres de vocês, todos os recenseados de vocês, segundo todo o número de vocês, de vinte anos para cima, que murmuraram contra {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.
pt.B: Aqui neste deserto cairão os corpos de vocês, de todos vocês que foram recenseados, o número inteiro de vocês, de vinte anos para cima, que reclamaram contra {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.
pt.R: Os corpos de vocês vão ficar caídos neste deserto. Todos vocês que foram contados, todos os que têm vinte anos ou mais e que reclamaram contra {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, vão morrer.

am.L: በዚህ ምድረ በዳ ሬሳችሁ ይወድቃል፤ በእኔ ላይ ያጉረመረማችሁ፣ ከሃያ ዓመትና ከዚያ በላይ የሆናችሁ፣ እንደ ቁጥራችሁ ሁሉ የተቆጠራችሁ ሁሉ [ይወድቃሉ]።
am.B: እዚሁ በዚህ ምድረ በዳ ሬሳችሁ ይወድቃል፤ ከሃያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ የሆናችሁ፣ የተቆጠራችሁ ሁሉ በሙሉ፣ በእኔ ላይ ያጉረመረማችሁ ሁሉ ትወድቃላችሁ።
am.R: ሬሳችሁ በዚህ ምድረ በዳ ይጋደማል። ከእናንተ የተቆጠረ፣ ዕድሜው ሃያ ዓመትና ከዚያ በላይ የሆነ፣ በእኔ ላይ ያጉረመረመ ሁሉ ይሞታል።

decisions.choice: your counted ones from twenty years old and upward: the men of the census
decisions.reason: These are the men counted in chapter 1, everyone twenty years old and upward who could go out to war (1:3, 45-46). The census was taken to prepare the army that would take the land; now the same list names those who will die in the wilderness. The new census in chapter 26 confirms it (26:64-65).

decisions.choice: corpses: dead bodies
decisions.reason: The word is the plain word for a dead body. Repeated in verses 32 and 33, it makes the sentence stark: the people will not only die but lie dead in the wilderness they chose.

decisions.choice: bodies / dead bodies
decisions.reason: Balanced says "bodies" and Readable "dead bodies"; Literal keeps "corpses".

decisions.choice: will die
decisions.reason: Readable adds "will die" at the end so the long list can stand as a clear sentence.

decisions.choice: "đã được kiểm tra (dân số)" for the counted ones
decisions.reason: The men of the census of chapter 1 (meaning decision); "kiểm tra dân số" is the word for census in the Vietnamese Exodus 30:12.

decisions.choice: "계수된" for those counted in the census
decisions.reason: The word ties the sentence to the census of chapter 1 (meaning decision); Balanced and Readable add "인구 조사" so the reader hears it.

source.text: אִם־אַתֶּם֙ תָּבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֨אתִי֙ אֶת־יָדִ֔י לְשַׁכֵּ֥ן אֶתְכֶ֖ם בָּ֑הּ כִּ֚י אִם־כָּלֵ֣ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּ֔ה וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־נֽוּן׃

records.literal_gloss: Surely not you will come into the land which I lifted my hand to make dwell you in it, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

en.L: Surely you will not come into the land which I lifted up {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand to settle you in it, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
en.B: You will certainly not enter the land that I raised {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand and swore to give you as a home, except for Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
en.R: None of you will go into the land I solemnly promised to give you as your home. Only Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun will go in.

es.L: Ciertamente {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} no {{plural_you:entrarán|entraréis}} en la tierra sobre la cual alcé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano para {{plural_you:hacerlos|haceros}} habitar en ella, excepto Caleb hijo de Jefone y Josué hijo de Nun.
es.B: De ninguna manera {{plural_you:entrarán|entraréis}} en la tierra por la que alcé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano y juré {{plural_you:darles|daros}} como hogar, excepto Caleb hijo de Jefone y Josué hijo de Nun.
es.R: Ninguno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} entrará en la tierra que prometí solemnemente {{plural_you:darles|daros}} como hogar. Solo entrarán Caleb hijo de Jefone y Josué hijo de Nun.

fr.L: Certainement vous n’entrerez pas dans le pays au sujet duquel j’ai levé {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main pour vous y établir, excepté Caleb fils de Jephounné et Josué fils de Noun.
fr.B: Vous n’entrerez certainement pas dans le pays que j’avais juré, la main levée, de vous donner pour demeure, excepté Caleb fils de Jephounné et Josué fils de Noun.
fr.R: Aucun de vous n’entrera dans le pays que j’avais promis solennellement de vous donner pour y habiter. Seuls Caleb, fils de Jephounné, et Josué, fils de Noun, y entreront.

sw.L: Hakika ninyi hamtaingia katika nchi niliyoinulia mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kuwakalisha ndani yake, isipokuwa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni.
sw.B: Hakika hamtaingia katika nchi ambayo niliinua mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} nikaapa kuwapa iwe makao yenu, isipokuwa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni.
sw.R: Hakuna hata mmoja wenu atakayeingia katika nchi niliyoahidi kwa kiapo kuwapa iwe makao yenu. Ni Kalebu mwana wa Yefune na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni tu watakaoingia.

vi.L: Chắc chắn các ngươi sẽ không vào xứ mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã giơ tay thề cho các ngươi ở, ngoại trừ Ca-lép con trai Giê-phu-nê và Giô-suê con trai Nun.
vi.B: Chắc chắn các ngươi sẽ không được vào xứ mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã giơ tay thề sẽ ban cho các ngươi làm nơi ở, ngoại trừ Ca-lép con trai Giê-phu-nê và Giô-suê con trai Nun.
vi.R: Không một ai trong các ngươi sẽ vào xứ mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã long trọng hứa ban cho các ngươi làm quê hương. Chỉ có Ca-lép con trai Giê-phu-nê và Giô-suê con trai Nun sẽ được vào.

ko.L: 내가 손을 들어 너희를 살게 하겠다고 한 그 땅에, 여분네의 아들 갈렙과 눈의 아들 여호수아 말고는, 너희가 결코 들어가지 못할 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 손을 들어 너희를 살게 하겠다고 맹세한 그 땅에, 너희는 결코 들어가지 못할 것이다. 다만 여분네의 아들 갈렙과 눈의 아들 여호수아만은 예외이다.
ko.R: 내가 너희가 살 곳으로 주겠다고 굳게 약속한 땅에 너희는 아무도 들어가지 못할 것이다. 여분네의 아들 갈렙과 눈의 아들 여호수아만 들어갈 것이다.

pt.L: Certamente vocês não entrarão na terra [pela qual] levantei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mão para fazer vocês habitarem nela, exceto Calebe, filho de Jefoné, e Josué, filho de Num.
